# We Have a Challenge

> A Field Guide for Solving Problems in Challenging Times, by Gijs Verrest and Jens Refflinghaus (Solving Forces). The book is in development. Readers can follow its progress through a free newsletter every two weeks, in English, German or Dutch.

The book is a practical guide for teams dealing with firefighting, recurring problems and ad-hoc actions: finding clarity, solving problems together and turning decisions into action. The authors are solution designers, facilitators and trainers with more than 45 years of combined problem-solving experience across industries.
